name: Beef grilled in lá lốt
summary: Beef grilled in lá lốt, sometimes with mỡ chài, and eaten with lettuce, herbs, green banana, cucumber, star fruit, and mắm nêm.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế says people here name bò nướng lá lốt, bò lá lốt, and thịt bò lá lốt for the same grilling.
howToEat: Grill beef in lá lốt. Mỡ chài may be added. Eat it with lettuce, basil, fish mint, green banana, cucumber, and star fruit, and dip it in mắm nêm.
The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Beef grilled in lá lốt in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Beef grilled in lá lốt with herbs, green banana, cucumber, star fruit, and mắm nêm.
